name: University City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun
short_description: University City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun is on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Aeon Mall Taman University, Johor Bahru in Johor Bahru, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The University City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun is a JomRun event based at Aeon Mall Taman University in Johor Bahru on 11 October 2026. It offers a 21.1 km competitive run with a TrackAsia RFID timing chip, plus 5 km and 10 km fun runs. JomRun lists the event time as 3:45 am; the race kit collection details and route map are still marked to be confirmed.

core_facts.venue: Aeon Mall Taman University, Johor Bahru

faqs.question: What time does the University City Half Marathon 2026 start?
faqs.answer: JomRun lists the event time as 3:45 am on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Aeon Mall Taman University. Separate flag-off times for each distance are not given in the page text.

faqs.question: What do 21.1 km runners receive?
faqs.answer: The 21.1 km competitive run entitlement includes an Ultron event jersey, a race bib with a TrackAsia RFID timing chip, an e-certificate and light refreshments. Finishers also receive a 21.1 km finisher medal and an Ultron finisher jersey.
